correctness.rationale: An order-four ASM is uniquely enumerated by legal alternating 1/3-nonzero rows with column partial sums 0 or 1 and final sums 1. This exhausts 42 labelled matrices, and their mod-3 affine row/column sum constraints give 9 independent coordinates and frequency restriction kernel size 3^7. Integer phase counts c0,c1,c2 over all 3^9=19683 reduced frequencies exactly determine |W|^2=c0^2+c1^2+c2^2-c0c1-c0c2-c1c2. Independent exhaustive recomputation found exactly 734 reduced zeros, 53 distinct squared magnitude levels, least positive squared value 3, maximum 1764, Parseval 42*19683=826686. Multiplication by 3^7 yields full nullity 1,605,258 and rank 41,441,463 in F3^16. Direct enumeration of every single/two-coordinate frequency gives zero at exactly the 16 opposite-sign central horizontal/vertical coordinate pairs, no weight-one zeros. Fourier diagonalization of UNNORMALIZED convolution gives T pseudoinverse norm 1/sqrt(3), condition number 14sqrt(3).
residual_risks: Complete finite theorem relies on correct implementation of the 42-point exact census; independent enumeration and separate monotone-triangle script reduce but do not formally eliminate implementation risk.
